deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL print `Goodbye, <name>!` when invoked with `--bye`.

requirement.name: Farewell
requirement.text: The system SHALL print `Goodbye, <name>!` when invoked with `--bye`.

scenarios.name: Farewell with name
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `greet --bye Ada`
- **THEN** the output is `Goodbye, Ada!`

deltas.description: Modify requirement: The system MUST greet the value of `GREET_DEFAULT` when no name argument is given, and "World" when it is unset.

requirement.name: Default greeting
requirement.text: The system MUST greet the value of `GREET_DEFAULT` when no name argument is given, and "World" when it is unset.

scenarios.name: No name given
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `greet` with no arguments and `GREET_DEFAULT` is unset
- **THEN** the output is `Hello, World!`

scenarios.name: Configured default
scenarios.rawText:
- **GIVEN** `GREET_DEFAULT=Grace`
- **WHEN** the user runs `greet` with no arguments
- **THEN** the output is `Hello, Grace!`
